details:
- CVE-2026-39820: rebuild against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to fix
  quadratic complexity in consumeComment in net/mail, where repeated string
  concatenation made nested comment depth O(n^2)
- CVE-2026-42499: rebuild against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to fix
  quadratic consumePhrase behavior in net/mail, which repeatedly concatenated
  encoded-word runs into the previous slice element
- CVE-2026-33818: rebuild against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to fix
  stack exhaustion in encoding/asn1 Unmarshal when parsing deeply-nested
  recursive structures
- CVE-2026-56853: rebuild against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to apply
  ReadHeaderTimeout to the server's unencrypted HTTP/2 client preface read, and
  clear the connection timeouts once the connection is handed off to http2
- CVE-2026-56858: rebuild against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to fix
  JavaScript regexp context tracking in html/template, where pathological input
  could close an unescaped '/' early and inject attacker-controlled content
- CVE-2026-56859: rebuild against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to fix
  stack exhaustion in encoding/xml, where DecodeElement reset the recursion
  depth counter
- CVE-2026-56860: rebuild against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to fix
  quadratic complexity in net/url resolvePath when resolving '..' segments
- CVE-2026-56862: rebuild against golang >= 1.25.7-1.el9_6.tuxcare.els16 to fix
  unbounded key derivation work in crypto/tls, where handshake messages still
  counted as state-advancing after the handshake completed
